decisions.reason: As the publicly announced flagship product line with several models and heavy investment, central to the firm's digital practice direction, management is strongly committed to continuing it.
The education institute builds on the firm's training resources and customer relationships, and any weak results can be attributed to temporary pandemic effects on in-person courses.
Remote support is low-cost, integral to the support offering, and gained relevance under remote working conditions, so there is no reason to withdraw it.
The analytics dashboard has its own page and fits the announced direction of efficiently managed, data-driven practices, which justifies persisting with it.
The complete practice bundle packages the core offer for new practices, so it requires little extra investment and is closely tied to the established business.

The listing portal is distant from the core offer and was only mentioned on the website, which makes it the most likely to be dropped, but it is cheap to maintain and supports community ties with customers.
